hints.title: Monotonic Square Search Space
hints.text: The square function is strictly monotonically increasing for positive integers. For any x greater than one, the integer square root must lie between one and x divided by two.

hints.title: Midpoint Square Bounding Invariant
hints.text: Comparing mid times mid against x allows narrowing the search interval by discarding the half that cannot contain the square root.

hints.title: Bisection Convergence Procedure
hints.text: If x is less than two, return x. Set low to one and high to x divided by two. While low is less than or equal to high, compute midpoint. If mid times mid is at most x, record mid as answer and advance low; otherwise decrease high. Return the recorded answer.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(log X) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Linear search from one upwards takes O(sqrt(X)) time and can trigger integer overflow during multiplication.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bisection narrows the interval logarithmically in O(log X) time using strictly O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should avoid floating point library calls, handle x=0 and x=1 boundaries, and guard against integer overflow.
